channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
compas_brep is a unified Brep (boundary representation) wrapper for the
COMPAS framework, with pluggable OCC and Rhino backends.

It provides a single `Brep` class with a stable public interface. The
backend is selected automatically at runtime based on what is importable,
and all inputs and outputs are COMPAS types rather than backend types, so
the same code runs against either kernel.

The OCC backend is optional and activates when the `ocp` package is
installed alongside compas-brep; it supports both the 7.x and 8.x series
of OCCT bindings. The Rhino backend activates automatically inside Rhino.
about.summary: Canonical Brep wrapper based on COMPAS framework with pluggable OCC/Rhino backends

name: compas-brep
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.4.0"

package:
  name: compas-brep
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/c/compas-brep/compas_brep-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a7801d60960374b15bd813c372969a04be7222cae4a3357af57aab709d1a8875

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - uv-build >=0.10.2,<0.11.0
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - compas >=2.0, <3.0
    - numpy
    - scipy
  run_constraints:
    - ocp >=7.9.2,<9

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - compas_brep
        - compas_brep.brep
        - compas_brep.backend
        - compas_brep.curves
        - compas_brep.surfaces
        - compas_brep.exchange
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/gramaziokohler/compas_brep
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Canonical Brep wrapper based on COMPAS framework with pluggable OCC/Rhino backends
  description: |
    compas_brep is a unified Brep (boundary representation) wrapper for the
    COMPAS framework, with pluggable OCC and Rhino backends.

    It provides a single `Brep` class with a stable public interface. The
    backend is selected automatically at runtime based on what is importable,
    and all inputs and outputs are COMPAS types rather than backend types, so
    the same code runs against either kernel.

    The OCC backend is optional and activates when the `ocp` package is
    installed alongside compas-brep; it supports both the 7.x and 8.x series
    of OCCT bindings. The Rhino backend activates automatically inside Rhino.
  repository: https://github.com/gramaziokohler/compas_brep
  documentation: https://gramaziokohler.github.io/compas_brep/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chenkasirer
